map.由角速度求频率 使用指南: Frequency from angular velocity user guide
map.由角速度求频率工具根据 f=ω/(2π) 将角速度换算为旋转频率，输入 ω 输出: The frequency-from-angular-velocity tool converts angular velocity to rotational frequency using f = ω/(2π); enter ω and get Hz, for unit conversion between angular and linear quantities in physics, motors and vibration analysis.
map.输入角速度 ω，求频率 f。: Enter angular velocity ω to get frequency f.
map.角速度转每秒圈数。: Convert angular velocity to cycles per second.
map.把角速度换算成每秒转多少圈的频率值。: Convert angular velocity into frequency in cycles per second.
map.：f = 6.283/(2π) = 6.283/6.283 = 1 Hz。即每秒: : f = 6.283/(2π) = 6.283/6.283 = 1 Hz. That is one revolution per second.
map.：f=ω/(2π)=15.708/6.28318=2.5000 Hz，即每秒转: : f = ω/(2π) = 15.708/6.28318 = 2.5000 Hz, that is 2.5 revolutions per second.
map.f = 1/T；频率是单位时间圈数，周期是一圈耗时，互为倒数。: f = 1/T; frequency is the number of cycles per unit time and period is the time of one cycle - they are reciprocals.
map.频率和周期、转速三者怎么换算？: How do you convert between frequency, period and rotation speed?
map.周期 T=1/f，所以本例 T=0.4 s；转速（rpm）=f×60=150 r: Period T = 1/f, so in this example T = 0.4 s; rotation speed (rpm) = f x 60 = 150 rpm. The three describe the same thing in different units: Hz is 'cycles per second' and rpm is 'revolutions per minute'.
